title: Verification as an Architectural Layer for LLM Agents: A V-Model Design, and a Pilot Study of Its Deterministic Core
abstract: arXiv:2609.31937v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents built on the ReAct pattern concentrate four responsibilities in one model: selecting a strategy, choosing each action, formatting it, and judging whether the result is adequate. Nothing outside the generative loop can reject its output, so an agent that cannot make progress does not report failure; it runs until an external budget stops it. We propose treating verification as an architectural layer by adapting the V-model from software engineering: specification levels descend from requirements to individual steps, each level is paired with a dedicated verifier, a deterministic controller enforces every verdict, and only verification outcomes write to memory, so a rejection localizes the level that introduced the fault and an agent halts by declining rather than by exhaustion. translated_title: 验证作为LLM智能体的架构层：V模型设计及其确定性核心的初步研究
translated_abstract: 基于ReAct模式构建的大语言模型（LLM）智能体将四种职责集中于一个模型之中：选择策略、选择每个动作、对其进行格式化，以及判断结果是否充分。生成循环之外没有任何环节能够拒绝其输出，因此无法取得进展的智能体不会报告失败，而是持续运行直到外部预算将其终止。我们提出将验证作为一种架构层，具体做法是改造软件工程中的V模型：规范层级自需求逐级下降至单个步骤，每个层级配有专用的验证器，由确定性控制器强制执行每项判定，且只有验证结果才会写入内存，从而使得拒绝操作能够定位引入故障的层级，智能体通过“拒绝”而非“耗尽”来停止运行。每个验证器将零成本的确定性“门控”与可选的LLM“评审”相分离，因此其贡献……
tldr: 提出借鉴软件工程的V模型，将验证作为LLM智能体的独立架构层——通过分层规范、专用验证器、确定性控制器以及仅写入验证结果的内存机制，使智能体在无法取得进展时能够主动拒绝并停止，而非无限运行直至耗尽外部预算。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes treating verification as an architectural layer for LLM agents by adapting the software engineering V-model—featuring hierarchical specifications, dedicated verifiers, a deterministic controller, and memory that only records verification outcomes—so that agents halt by declining rather than by exhausting their external budget.
